transport_findings.status: Investigated by agent; not waiting on user
transport_findings.ha_success: Not a device-completion certificate: current upstream Shelly authentication exceptions and unavailable entity filtering can return normally without a completed command.
transport_findings.implementation: HA callbacks only enqueue acceptance. Tracker retains pending ON until separately qualified command-correlated device completion plus subsequent matching report. Unknown delivery latches OFF; reinitialization preserves pending requests.
transport_findings.remaining: Qualify and implement a concrete stronger transport adapter and recovery procedure; no generic reset may erase unresolved ON. Current HA-only guard will latch after 15 seconds for unresolved ON.
transport_findings.qualification: Reviewed upstream source, not installed runtime versions or physical hardware.
